cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(gpd_shared_bridge LANGUAGES C CXX)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
get_target_property(EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR Eigen3::Eigen INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
include_directories(${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR})
add_subdirectory(upstream/gpd author)
find_package(PCL REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)
add_executable(gpd_shared_bridge bridge.cpp)
target_compile_features(gpd_shared_bridge PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(gpd_shared_bridge PRIVATE upstream/gpd/include ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(gpd_shared_bridge PRIVATE gpd_grasp_detector)
